chapter.verse: Note' lakah nulepa tatkhialhna om cih thu kigen a, Gentile mite' lakah zong a omlo nam, mi khat in a pa' zi mawhpih cih thu nangawn om tanghial hi.
Tua kimlai na kiphasak lailai tazen uh hi! Na dah ding uh hizaw lo ahi hiam? Hih banga gamta mi, note' lakpan kihemkhia ta hen.
A hang pen pumpi tawh kong om loh hangin kha tawh hong om ka hih manin pumpi tawh hong om dan mahin hih banga a gamta mi' tungah thukhenna a pia khinta ka hi hi.
Topa Jesu' min tawh na kikhop uh ciangin i Topa Jesu' vangliatna tungtawnin note tawh ka kha hong om ahih manin
tua mipa Topa' ni ah a kha a suahtak ding deihna-in pumpi siatcipna a tuak dingin Satan' kiangah na ap ding uh hi.
Note' kisialhpih thu pen a hoih hilo hi. Silngo themno khat in annel a lompi bup pawmsak thei cih thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Annel lom thak na suah nadingun—zong, silngo sawh nailoh hi takpi pah na hih manun—silngo lui na hahsiang un. A hang pen Khris, i Paisan Pawi tuuno, pen biakpiakna-in kigo khinzo hi.
Tua hangin silngo lui ahi, huatna leh gitlohna silngo zang lo-in silngo sawhloh anlum ahi ngimna siangtho leh thumaan thutak tawh Paisan Pawi bawl ni.
Note kong laikhak sungah nulepa vai a takhial mite tawh kithuah loh ding kong gelh hi.
Tua pen hih leitunga nulepa vai a takhial mite, duhhop huaihamte, mikhemte leh milim biate cihna hi peuhmah lo hi. Hi hileh leitung pan na paikhiat uh kul ding hi.

Tu-in ahihleh sanggam cih min pua napi nulepa vai a takhial, a duhhop a huaiham, milim bia, mi kosia, zukham, mikhem cih bang a om leh na kithuah loh nading uh—zong, an nangawn na nekkhop loh nadingun—kong gelh hi.
A hang pen a pualam mite' vai ah thukhen dingin kisaina nei ka hi hiam? Note' thukhen ding pen a sunga omte hilo ahi hiam?
Pasian in a pualam mite' vai na khen ding hi. Tua hi a, “a tatsia mi, note' kiangpan hawlkhia un.”
